name: Sid Meier's Civilization V: Cradle of Civilization Map Pack - Mediterranean
summary: The Cradle of Civilization Map Pack: Mediterranean includes a single-player map focused on the Mediterranean region. It features the geographic layout of the area, highlighting key coastal and inland features relevant to ancient civilizations. Players can choose random leaders or leaders tied to the historical context of the region. The map is also compatible with the World Builder tool for creating custom scenarios.
